title: Cameras Roll in Venice for the Sequel to 'Upgraded'
summary:
Filming is underway in Venice for "Upgraded 2," the sequel to the 2024 romantic comedy "Upgraded." Camila Mendes returns as Ana Santos, and Leslie Bibb will star alongside her. Bibb's role is not yet known.

In the first film, Ana is an intern at a New York City auction house. She pretends to hold a higher job after she is upgraded to first class on her flight to London. During the flight, she impresses William, a wealthy young Englishman played by Archie Renaux, from the art world. The sequel is described as a modern-day "Cinderella" tale.

Cameras started rolling in Venice on October 21. In the sequel, Ana is seemingly seeking to make her mark at the Venice Biennale, described as the world's oldest contemporary art fair. Becca Gleason is directing the sequel, replacing Carlson Young. Luke Roberts and Justin Matthews also wrote the screenplay.

Filming has taken place on the terrace of Ca' Giustinian, the Biennale headquarters. After 12 days in Venice, filming will move to Rome for 33 more days, according to Italy for Movies.
why_it_matters: It can remind you that starting small, like an intern, does not stop you from aiming for a bigger goal.
